title: Aaron Hyman, Toldot Tannaim ve-Amoraim: reading edition with English translation
description:
The biographical dictionary of the Talmudic sages: a machine translation of all 1,889 entries, and reviewed sample entries.

Machine translation paragraph by paragraph (Gemini via OpenRouter), shown next to the Hebrew; two sample entries translated with Claude and checked.

Read online: https://openseforim.org/hyman/
